_note: Devices is Thuso Kit: the device registry and its health, readings asked for by everything but their value and linked to where the Health Passport keeps it, wearable link requests that connect nothing, and kits issued against a recorded deposit. Wave 2 contract; built on the engine runtime in Wave 4, when every version-one route was withdrawn for a version that refuses what the first could not, and the two vendor doors were added to packages/catalog/feeds.json. packages/catalog/devices.json holds the kinds, marks, words and settings.
